description: Implementation of the DU setup procedure for a 5G network, including cell configuration, F1 setup request/response handling, and cell activation logic.

classes.name: du_setup_procedure
classes.description: Handles the setup process for DU, including cell configuration, F1 setup, and activation.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine executing the DU setup procedure, including retries for TNL connection, F1 setup, and cell activation.

methods.name: configure_du_cells
methods.description: Configures DU cells based on the request, including MAC cell configuration.

methods.name: start_f1_setup_request
methods.description: Prepares and sends an F1 setup request to the network.

methods.name: handle_f1_setup_response
methods.description: Handles the response from the F1 setup request, activating cells on success or handling errors.
